static_traits.name: Lin Jun
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of supportive friends and mother as a support system; but often feels excluded and misunderstood in social situations, finding it hard to build intimate relationships
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-reflect and identify thinking biases; highly cooperative, positive attitude; slightly anxious at the first visit

basic_info.main_problem: I believe that at school, because I said my favorite subject was science, the kids did not like me, producing feelings of being rejected and isolated; these feelings began in student years and continued into adulthood, affecting self-esteem and social life; I often feel stressed and rejected in social situations or when trying to make new friends.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of being rejected are affecting my ability to build meaningful relationships and my mental health.
growth_experiences: Experienced peer rejection and bullying in student years; seen by classmates as 'different' for expressing love of science, which raised stress and produced feelings of being rejected and isolated; academic performance was affected; these experiences continued into adulthood and keep affecting self-esteem and interpersonal interaction.
Family: mother had cancer and recovered; a major family event.

special_situations.event: After publicly saying science was the favorite subject in student years, feeling that classmates all disliked one
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my interests differ from most people's and I reveal my true preferences, I will be rejected and disliked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries hard to cater to others, attempts to be more extroverted to seek recognition, or hides real interests in socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not like me because I like science

special_situations.event: At a friend's party last week received mixed signals (someone smiled and greeted me, someone else gave me a strange look), but I still felt unwelcome and left early
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative cues are more credible than positive feedback; if not everyone is warm, I am not needed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on negative cues, reduces interaction and withdraws to avoid embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want me here; I do not belong here

special_situations.event: When trying to join a conversation, someone looks at me with a 'strange' look
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others' expressions are not friendly enough, it shows they despise me or find me weird
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding conversation and reducing self-exposure to protect oneself from evaluation

special_situations.event: In unfamiliar social settings or when trying to make new friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others have not yet immediately shown clear acceptance, they will never like me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presumes negative outcomes and reduces proactive contact to avoid possible rejection and humiliation

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be accepted, liked, and able to build meaningful intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected, humiliated, and excluded by peers again, worried that exposing the real self will bring harm
defense_goal: Avoiding being rejected or embarrassed by keeping distance and reducing self-exposure
Withdraws socially to maintain self-esteem and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A rejected outsider, easily embarrassed and unneeded
object_relations.object_representation: Indifferent and critical groups/peers who may reject and mock at any time

manifestations: Long-term feelings of being rejected and isolated
Assuming one is not liked in social situations and withdrawing
Difficulty forming intimate relationships; often feels misunderstood

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Leaves parties early to avoid direct interaction
Reduces conversation and self-disclosure in social settings
When facing mixed signals, avoiding positive contact and focusing on negative cues

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Believes 'if I try to talk it will only make things worse or embarrass me'
Overly worries about others' evaluations before contacting people, limiting one's initiative

positive_force: Has supportive friends and mother as a support system
Able to notice and name cognitive biases (such as noticing oneself focusing only on the negative)
Positive attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments and new perspectives
negative_force: In socializing, catastrophizes and overgeneralizes, tends toward mind reading and personalization
Mental filtering leads to ignoring positive cues, reinforcing the sense of being rejected
Social avoidance and withdrawal, assuming negative outcomes, reducing interaction opportunities
Impaired self-esteem, highly sensitive to others' evaluations

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and withdrawal (talking less in social situations, leaving early, avoiding self-exposure)
antecedent: Being in an unfamiliar social environment or trying to make new friends
When attending gatherings and trying to join conversations
Noticing others' uncertain or slightly negative expressions/feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: The student-years experience of rejection and bullying internalized as the core belief 'I am not liked / will be rejected'; catastrophizing predictions and mind reading in current social life trigger strong anxiety and shame, leading to withdrawal for self-protection
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential rejection, humiliation, and embarrassment to protect self-esteem and security
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building and maintaining intimate relationships; feels isolated and misunderstood; self-esteem further damaged
